label: Francesca Lanfredini
roles: wife of ser Piero da Vinci
summary: Second wife of ser Piero, married about 1464 or 1465.

value.text: Second wife of ser Piero, married about 1464 or 1465.

claims.statement: Francesca di ser Giuliano Lanfredini married ser Piero about 1464 (another source gives c.1465 to 1466) and died before his third marriage of 1475. No children recorded.

sources.cite: Sepoltuario fiorentino online database (University of Virginia), entry for Lanfredini, Francesca di ser Giuliano di Giovanni di Filippo (entry number not confirmed). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.
